ios.desc:
Volo is the flight tracker built for how people actually travel — together.

Whether you're coordinating a group trip, keeping tabs on a connecting flight, or checking if your airport is running on time, Volo gives you the real-time intelligence you need in a clean, intuitive experience.

▶ REAL-TIME FLIGHT TRACKING
- Live flight status with departure, arrival, and gate info
- Smart filters by airline, status, and route
- Flight Connector logic surfaces connection risks before they happen

▶ AIRPORT PERFORMANCE CARDS
- On-time performance data for your airport.
- See delay trends by airline and route at a glance
- Know what you're walking into before you even leave home

▶ SMART NOTIFICATIONS
- Timely alerts for gate changes, delays, and departures
- Notifications designed to inform, not overwhelm

▶ CLEAN & FOCUSED
- Built for passengers first — no clutter, no noise
- Fast search by flight number or route
- Designed for one-handed use on the go

Volo is free to download. Premium features available for free.
